# Identify spam threads involving friend emails

spam_thread_ids = [t['email_thread_id'] for t in spam_threads]
print('spam_thread_total', len(spam_thread_ids))

friend_thread_ids = []
other_spam_thread_ids = []

for t in spam_threads:
    participants = t.get('participants', []) or []
    participant_emails = {p.get('email','').lower() for p in participants if p.get('email')}
    is_friend = len(participant_emails & friend_emails) > 0
    if is_friend:
        friend_thread_ids.append(t['email_thread_id'])
    else:
